Your experience

A little direction.
A lot of you.

We begin with how you want to feel in the photographs. A personal portrait, an editorial idea or a creative profile each asks for a different mood. I help shape the light, location and movement, so you can focus on being present.

Portrait sessions can take place outdoors, in the city or in a studio arranged for the shoot. I work across the Netherlands, including Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, The Hague. Studio hire is discussed separately where needed.

Before we begin

A few things
you may wonder.

Do I need modelling experience?

No. We’ll discuss the mood and work through the session together. Simple movement and small changes in posture are often enough to create expressive photographs.

Can I use the photographs for my work?

Tell me how you plan to use them — for example a personal profile, creative portfolio or business campaign. The intended use and any commercial licence are included in the proposal.

Can we shoot in a studio?

Yes, a studio can be arranged when it suits the idea. Availability, location fees and any additional production needs are agreed before booking.

Will the photographs be in colour or black and white?

We’ll discuss your preferences and the mood of the session. My portfolio includes both warm cinematic colour and expressive black and white; the final treatment follows the story.

Planning your session

A little preparation.

What to wear for a couples, portrait or family photoshoot

Choose clothes you can move, sit and breathe comfortably in. The most useful outfit is one that feels like you and works with the location. A cinematic photograph does not require a special wardrobe.
